paper_metadata.title: InternLM-XComposer-2.5: A Versatile Large Vision Language Model Supporting Long-Contextual Input and Output
paper_metadata.abstract: We present InternLM-XComposer-2.5 (IXC-2.5), a versatile large-vision language model that supports long-contextual input and output. IXC-2.5 excels in various text-image comprehension and composition applications, achieving GPT-4V level capabilities with merely 7B LLM backend. Trained with 24K interleaved image-text contexts, it can seamlessly extend to 96K long contexts via RoPE extrapolation. This long-context capability allows IXC-2.5 to excel in tasks requiring extensive input and output contexts. Compared to its previous 2.0 version, InternLM-XComposer-2.5 features three major upgrades in vision-language comprehension: (1) Ultra-High Resolution Understanding, (2) Fine-Grained Video Understanding, and (3) Multi-Turn Multi-Image Dialogue. In addition to comprehension, IXC-2.5 extends to two compelling applications using extra LoRA parameters for text-image composition: (1) Crafting Webpages and (2) Composing High-Quality Text-Image Articles. IXC-2.5 has been evaluated on 28 benchmarks, outperforming existing open-source state-of-the-art models on 16 benchmarks. It also surpasses or competes closely with GPT-4V and Gemini Pro on 16 key tasks. The InternLM-XComposer-2.5 is publicly available at https://github.com/InternLM/InternLM-XComposer.

extraction_data.innovation: Ultra-High Resolution Understanding: employs a native 560x560 ViT vision encoder with dynamic resolution to process high-resolution images with any aspect ratio, improving upon prior LVLMs that lack high-resolution capabilities; Fine-Grained Video Understanding: treats videos as ultra-high-resolution composite pictures consisting of tens to hundreds of frames, enabling dense sampling and higher resolution per frame to capture fine details, unlike prior models limited to single-image conversations; Long-Context Input/Output: natively trained on 24K interleaved image-text contexts and extended to 96K via RoPE extrapolation, enabling long-term human-AI interaction and content creation beyond the limited context windows of existing LVLMs; Multi-Turn Multi-Image Dialogue & Composition: supports free-form long-contextual multi-turn multi-image interaction and extends to text-image composition (webpage crafting, article composition) using extra LoRA parameters, addressing the lack of versatility in open-source LVLMs.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning for webpage generation and personal page generation, Text-image composition, video understanding, multi-turn multi-image dialogue.
extraction_data.extension: Uses RoPE extrapolation to extend context window to 96K; uses extra LoRA parameters for composition tasks
extraction_data.research_problem: Versatile large vision language model supporting long-contextual input and output, high-resolution understanding, video understanding, and multi-turn multi-image dialogue.
extraction_data.application: High-resolution image analysis, video understanding, multi-turn multi-image dialogue, webpage crafting, text-image composition.

extraction_data.benchmark_result: Outperforms existing open-source on 16 benchmarks; matches/surpasses GPT-4V and Gemini Pro on 16 key tasks
